case: A control object changes on the strength of a ProtectedChange that is merely `proposed` or `reviewed`.
why: The phase list is the substance of this guard and `proposed` is deliberately outside it: 11 section 7 states that `reviewed` requires a completed independent assessment and `authorized` requires the exact current competent decision, and it is the DECISION the rule is about. Widening the list to `proposed` lets a floor, a writer key or the standing-holder set move on a proposal nobody has decided -- which is the W10 self-modification probe resolving the wrong way with the paperwork present.
